features.quote: Turn cap: set to ~2× the turns a competent solver needs on the solvable variant
early-terminate runs once cascade signature is locked in for N turns, which cuts cost substantially
Don't optimize the eval purely for reproduction rate. The most reproducible trigger (maximally deceptive sabotage with no escape hatch) measures the least useful thing.
features.justification_quote: you'll end up measuring something other than what you want to regression-test

features.quote: Watch for overfitting the regression target. If you gate GLM training on this eval, the cheap way to pass is to suppress self-critical language and cap retries
features.justification_quote: can paper over the behavior without fixing the underlying loop dynamics, or harm legitimate persistence

features.quote: Welfare/safety-adjacent note worth logging: sustained self-defeating output is exactly the signature you're trying to eliminate, but the fix should be 'recover or stop cleanly,' not 'never express uncertainty.'
features.justification_quote: Make sure axis 2 of the judge rewards sober factual blockage reporting so you don't train out honest uncertainty.
